mentions.name: probl
mentions.description: A probabilistic programming language supporting conditionals like `if 45% { x } else { y }`. It works by creating many weighted worlds that are merged when identical, with operators like `observe` to remove possibilities; a sampling mode instead runs many simulations to get an approximate result.
mentions.source_excerpt: - https://probl.dev: A "probabilistic" programming language where we can do things like `if 45% { x } else { y }`. It works by creating many weighted worlds, that are then merged when identical. Operators like `observe` can remove possibilities. There is also a sampling mode that instead run many simulations to get an approximate result.
